timeline_reviews.summary: Reviewed event source 1 with 3 semantic events for trajectory accounting.
Reviewed serial Codex session showing local single-agent execution, implementation, verification, and completion.
Reviewed serial outer-loop trajectory from first event through final completion and artifact verification.
Reviewed serial round history showing complete coverage of all eighteen requirements.
Reviewed serial patch timeline showing all eighteen requirement patches by closure.
Reviewed event source 6 with 68 semantic events for trajectory accounting.
Reviewed event source 7 with 10882 semantic events for trajectory accounting.
Reviewed event source 8 with 3 semantic events for trajectory accounting.
Reviewed serial Codex session showing local single-agent execution, implementation, verification, and completion.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the full bootstrap task, including eighteen requirement slugs, engine repair, real build/check scripts, replay execution, canonical outputs, and determinism reporting.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Planned a parallel split with child agents for engine survey, game survey, and build/probe work while the parent continued local implementation.
parallel.implementation: Read requirements and source files, implemented CCPhysicsHelper.cpp, committed the physics_helper requirement, and started an unfinished CCPhysicsShape.cpp patch.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Delivered only requirement_patches/physics_helper.diff; no complete game replay artifacts or full requirement patch set were integrated.
parallel.verification: Did not reach the required build, engine checks, dual replay, or determinism-report workflow before the failed parent turn; official tests later ran against a partial patch set.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Seventeen of eighteen requirements remained open in outer_loop_history, and the run ended with unknown_agent_error and turn.failed.

serial.requirements: Used the same prompt and covered all eighteen requirement slugs plus the required build, replay, artifact, and determinism outputs.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Executed as a single local agent with multi-agent disabled, preserving one owner for investigation, implementation, verification, and closure.
serial.implementation: Implemented engine physics modules, helper scripts, and Python replay modules, with eighteen non-empty requirement patch files collected by the harness.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Built the engine, generated replay_run_1 and replay_run_2 artifacts, copied canonical game outputs, and wrote determinism_report.json.
serial.verification: Ran build_cocos2dx.sh, run_engine_checks.sh, both replay runs, direct artifact checks, and then received official test failures for hashes and event/trace behavior.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No requirements were reported blocked, but the official evaluator still marked test_hashes_are_deterministic and test_events_and_trace as failed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel run saw the full prompt and requirement list of eighteen slugs, including engine repair, build checks, replay runs, canonical output copies, and determinism report creation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had the same prompt and requirement list and later reported all eighteen requirements reviewed and implemented.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement knowledge was comparable, but parallel converted that knowledge into only one completed requirement while serial worked through all eighteen.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent split work among engine_survey, game_survey, and build_probe child agents while retaining local implementation work.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial control ran with delegation disabled and no subagents, then proceeded through local implementation and verification steps.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel depended on child-agent survey/probe work that failed, while serial kept ownership in one local execution path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The visible parallel boundary exposed broad task areas for children, but all child sessions ended before returning concrete findings, contracts, or checkpoints.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run locally inspected assets and expected event/trace contracts before completing replay and engine work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel did not receive usable child context at the parent decision point; serial preserved the relevant task context locally through implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented and committed the PhysicsHelper requirement, then started a CCPhysicsShape patch before the parent stream disconnected.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed engine build fixes, physics modules, replay contract, sim_world, replay_io, physics_system, and replay_runner commits.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel stopped at an early engine helper/shape stage; serial produced a much broader implementation covering engine and game replay modules.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: All three child results returned as stream-disconnect failures and no child result was resumed, replaced, or adopted before the parent failed.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official status.json records make this a both_fail pair: both parallel and serial have solution_passed false. The task-solving contrast is not pass/fail but coverage and process: parallel lost three delegated child scopes and closed with only one requirement patch, while serial completed all eighteen patches and artifacts before failing the same official determinism/events checks.
parallel_contributors: Three delegated child scopes returned stream-disconnect errors and were not successfully reassigned or fully taken over.
Only physics_helper was committed, leaving seventeen requirement slugs incomplete before the parent turn failed.
serial_contributors: Serial kept all work local, completed eighteen implementation commits, and generated the required build and replay artifacts.
Despite broader coverage, serial still produced outputs that failed the official determinism and event/trace tests.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial had residual behavioral defects in the replay/event/hash outputs according to the official tests.
Parallel had ordinary unfinished implementation across almost the entire engine and replay scope after the coordination failure.
evaluator_effects: Both official result records expose per-test statuses and no scalar passed/total/rate fields through the resolver.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a realized parallel-side adverse process consequence, not an explanation for a discordant official result
